description: This file defines a CuTe-inspired Layout class for internal bookkeeping of device mesh ranks and transformations, including methods for coalescing, composition, complement, rank calculations, and remapping device ranks, used in distributed tensor computations.

classes.name: _MeshLayout
classes.description: A CuTe-inspired layout class for representing tensor dimension sizes and strides, with methods for manipulation and rank calculations in distributed device meshes.

methods.name: coalesce
methods.description: Merges consecutive dimensions if their strides are contiguous, simplifying the layout.

methods.name: composition
methods.description: Performs per-dimension composition of layouts, akin to function composition.

methods.name: complement
methods.description: Calculates the layout complement to fill in missing dimensions for a given world size.

methods.name: all_ranks_from_zero
methods.description: Enumerates all ranks generated by the layout starting from zero.

methods.name: check_non_overlap
methods.description: Checks if the layout's generated indices overlap.

methods.name: remap_to_tensor
methods.description: Remaps device ranks according to a rank map tensor, used for device assignment in distributed tensors.
